id.description: ULID — 26 chars, Crockford base32, no I/L/O/U.

type.comment: MUST stay in sync with DOC_TYPES in ../types.ts (the single source of truth). The frontmatter.test.ts drift-guard fails the build if these diverge.

privacy.description: Privacy tier for AI operations. 'local-only' forces local LLM provider regardless of user settings; 'default' follows global privacyTier setting.

forgotten.description: Cognee-style forget() primitive (Phase C Wave C3 / Story 2). If true (or an ISO-timestamp string marking when the user invoked forget()), this note is excluded from active retrieval (Tier1-BM25, Tier2-embeddings, hybrid-RRF, PPR-spreading-activation). The note remains on disk for audit / recovery; an explicit unforget() removes the field. Absent = not forgotten (backwards-compat with legacy notes).

encoded.description: Encoding-context captured at note creation time. Used by the Encoding-Context-Match-Boost (Tulving 1973) to boost retrieval when the query-time context matches the encoding-time context. All fields optional; absent block is the default for legacy notes.
